demand: Private notes service: accounts, per-owner notes CRUD, title search, throttled sign-in.

tasks.title: Accounts and sessions

contract.goal: People register and sign in; sessions expire after 8 hours.
acceptance: Passwords of 10-128 characters are stored salted and hashed
Login returns a random bearer token; only its hash is stored

tasks.notes: Registering an address that already exists answers 409 so people know to sign in instead.

contract.goal: Owners create, read, update and delete their notes.
acceptance: Every note query is restricted to the caller's user id
Title <= 200 and body <= 10000 characters; request bodies <= 64 KB

tasks.title: Title search

contract.goal: Owners search their notes by title.
acceptance: GET /notes?q=<text> returns up to 100 of the caller's notes whose title contains the text
Wildcard characters in the text are matched literally

tasks.notes: Search text is limited to 100 characters.

tasks.title: Sign-in throttling

contract.goal: Repeated failed sign-ins are refused for a while.
acceptance: After 5 failures for the same e-mail and client address within 15 minutes, login answers 429
A successful sign-in clears the counter

tasks.notes: Counters are kept in memory per process.
